MERIDIAN PACIFIC HOLDINGS LIMITED
(Incorporated in the Cayman Islands with limited liability)
Stock Code: 1288.HK — Main Board, The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited
ANNUAL REPORT — Financial Year Ended 31 December 2024
Prepared under International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS)
Presentation currency: Hong Kong Dollars (HKD)

--- CHAIRMAN'S STATEMENT (extract) ---

Meridian Pacific operates cloud-based logistics software for freight forwarders
across Greater China, Singapore, Malaysia and Vietnam. The Group serves 1,840
enterprise customers, up from 1,610 in the prior year. Founder and Chairman
Mr. Terence Lau controls 41.2% of issued shares through Meridian Pacific
Investments Ltd (BVI). Free float is 38.9%. The Group joined the Hang Seng
Composite SmallCap Index in September 2024.

Top five customers accounted for 24.1% of revenue (FY2023: 19.8%).
Revenue by geography: Mainland China 58%, Singapore 17%, Malaysia 13%,
Vietnam 8%, other 4%. Approximately 61% of revenue is denominated in RMB.
The Group does not hedge RMB exposure. Management estimates constant-currency
revenue growth of 17.4% versus reported growth of 15.7%.

Bank borrowings of HKD 800m mature as follows: HKD 180m within one year,
HKD 420m in years two to three, HKD 200m in years four to five. Borrowings
carry a covenant requiring net debt / EBITDA below 3.0x; the ratio at year end
was 0.4x. Mr. Terence Lau has pledged 6.8% of issued share capital as security
for a personal facility (FY2023: 4.1%).

Weighted average shares outstanding: 1,412m (FY2023: 1,388m).
Outstanding share options and RSUs: 96m, representing 6.8% potential dilution.

The Group operates its PRC business through a variable interest entity (VIE),
Shenzhen Meridian Information Technology Co. Ltd, consolidated by contractual
arrangement rather than equity ownership. The VIE contributed 54% of Group
revenue. Related-party receivables from entities controlled by the Chairman
totalled HKD 61m (FY2023: HKD 22m).

The Board recommends a final dividend of HKD 0.058 per share, representing a
payout ratio of 30% (FY2023: 32%). The Group has paid a dividend in each of
the past six financial years.

--- CORPORATE GOVERNANCE (extract) ---

The Board comprises eight directors: three executive, two non-executive and
three independent non-executive directors. The Audit Committee consists of
three independent non-executive directors and is chaired by Ms. Priya
Raghunathan, a qualified accountant. The auditor is a Big Four firm and issued
an unqualified opinion. The roles of Chairman and Chief Executive are held by
the same individual, Mr. Terence Lau, a deviation from code provision C.2.1,
which the Board considers appropriate given the Group's stage of development.

Executive remuneration comprises base salary, an annual cash bonus tied to
revenue and operating profit targets, and share awards vesting over four years.
No director has a service contract exceeding three years.

During the year the Group acquired a 24% stake in Kingsway Freight Analytics
for HKD 140m. Kingsway is 15% owned by a family trust of which Mr. Terence Lau
is a discretionary beneficiary. The transaction was approved by independent
shareholders at an extraordinary general meeting.

--- ESG (extract) ---

The Group reports Scope 1 and Scope 2 emissions but does not disclose Scope 3.
No third-party assurance was obtained for the ESG statement.
